about: P68V T9: hand-written minigolf game for e2e/play-minigolf.spec.ts – an L-shaped hole in a haunted house, three pumpkin bumpers and a moving coffin. POST /api/play/games with { spec, seed }. Same spec as SAMPLE in src/play/genre/__tests__/minigolf-module.test.ts (compileMinigolf of 'mini golf in a haunted house with pumpkins and a moving coffin', bends 1, obstacles 3; gate-passing on seeds 1-10).

objective.description: Putt the ball around the obstacles into the hole in as few strokes as you can.

tutorial.goalLine: Sink the ball in as few strokes as you can!
tutorial.controlsHint: Drag back from the ball and let go. Keys: arrows aim, hold Space.
